messages:
Maria: Quick preflight for optoral-14b split weights + serving config before canary. weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/optoral-14b/split/v1/
Chris: ack, can you paste the model sha + the config you're planning to run?
Maria: sha: a3f9d2c (short). config I'm planning to use:
```json
{
  "continuous_batching": true,
  "max_batch_size": 48,
  "max_batch_latency_ms": 30,
  "kv_cache_policy": "auto_pin_prefix",
  "cache_ttl_sec": 7200,
  "scheduler": "bucketed_fair",
  "max_total_tokens": 4096
}
```
Chris: looks reasonable. two quick notes: 1) this model's tokenizer is sentencepiece — do NOT set add_bos=true, we've seen duplicated  token in chats. 2) ensure the weights.index.json is present next to the shards (serving relies on it for split lookups).
Sanjeev: re scheduler: bucketed_fair is fine but set min_free_gpu_mem_mb: 1200 to avoid OOM spikes during regen tests. also recommend max_batch_size 40 for tail-safety on A100s with 40GB.
Olga: cache policy auto_pin_prefix is fine for chat workloads, but for embeddings we prefer lower cache_ttl. also include a stable cache key like `model:optoral-14b:v1:prefix` to avoid collisions across rollouts.
Maria: thanks — tokenizer.json currently had "add_bos": true, I'll flip that. weights.index.json is at s3://redwood-models/optoral-14b/split/v1/weights.index.json (confirmed).
Eva: can you run a small smoke with continuous_batching simulated traffic: continuous_batch_size=8 and latency target 25ms? I'll watch Console traces and token-level breakdowns.
Maria: starting smoke now — command I'm using:
```bash
rctl serve start --model s3://redwood-models/optoral-14b/split/v1 --config /tmp/optoral-srv.json --canary
```
deploy-bot: canary deployment started for Maria on cluster redwood-gpu-pool-3 (task id t-7241)
Chris: FYI if you see KV cache thrashing, bump cache_ttl to 3600 and drop max_batch_size to 32; that smooths req-to-req variance.
Maria: first smoke run results: "cold_kv_cache_miss": 12, p99_latency_ms: 240 under our simulated load — higher than goal.
Olga: 240ms p99 for a cold run is expected. try a warm-prefix-cache test: reuse the same prompts to populate KV cache, then re-run.
Maria: warmed run results: p99 48ms, mean 22ms :thumbsup:
Maria: updating config to: max_batch_size=40, cache_ttl_sec=3600, min_free_gpu_mem_mb=1200 and will re-run smoke.
Sanjeev: add a rollout policy: canary_traffic:10%, wait:15m, fallback_model:optoral-14b-quant if we hit OOM or QPS regression.
Maria: added rollout policy and pinned eos_token_id. tagging @prod-sig for FYI :eyes:
Olga: one last note — tokenizer EOS id for this pack is 2; ensure runtime has `eos_token_id: 2` else off-by-one truncation shows up in generated completions.
Maria: updated runtime conf and pushed to branch. rerunning smoke.
Chris: approve from me on the config changes. merge after final smoke green :rocket:
Eva: final smoke passed; traces look clean, tail latencies stable. recommend increasing canary to 50% for the next hour and watch memory + error budget.
Maria: bumping canary to 50% now. thanks everyone!
deploy-bot: canary traffic increased to 50% for deployment t-7241
